text:
Maya Patel: Hey team — kicking off CitriTech onboarding. Goal is to have a pilot live in ~30 days. Need alignment on stakeholders, SSO, data ingestion, and success criteria. @Liam can you confirm infra/instance sizing?

Liam Chen: Yep — estimating 2 dedicated GPUs for initial pilot, can scale later. Need sample traffic profile.

Sara Gomez: I'll collect business stakeholders & product owners today. Planning an enablement session next Tue.

Ethan Brooks: Heads-up: CitriTech wants PII redaction in pipeline. We should confirm which fields they consider sensitive.

Maya Patel: Good call. Sara — can you ask them for a sanitized sample of 1–2k records and a list of required redaction fields?

Sara Gomez: On it. Also scheduling: proposed milestones below — comments?

OnboardBot: ``Kickoff milestones:
- Day 0: Stakeholder intro + access (SSO, Jira, onboarding workspace)
- Day 3–7: Data ingest & validation, sample prompts collected (target 50)
- Day 10–14: Internal evals, baseline metrics (accuracy/QA)
- Day 20–30: Pilot launch, enablement + monitoring in console
- Day 30+: Collect usage signals, discuss Dedicated capacity``

Liam Chen: For infra, we need the sample QPS and average seq length. If they expect heavy long-context use, we should plan for 24GB+ models or quantized variants.

Maya Patel: Success criteria proposal: latency p95 < 300ms for interactive flows, baseline automated QA accuracy >= 85% on the eval set, and <2% safety/regression flags in production. Renewal risk trigger: weekly active user rate < 40% of projected after 30d or >5% critical errors.

Ethan Brooks: Adding enablement asks: run one live walkthrough with product owners, provide 1-pager prompt guide, and hand over troubleshooting runbook.

Sara Gomez: I'll confirm dates with CitriTech for the enablement session and request the sanitized sample + expected traffic tonight.

Maya Patel: Action items: Sara — collect sample + stakeholder roster by EOD. Liam — confirm instance sizing once sample traffic arrives. Ethan — draft runbook + prompt guide; share by Fri. I'll own tracking success metrics and renewal signal definitions.

Liam Chen: Acked. Will prepare a short infra checklist and a fallback plan (hosted fallback model) in case of capacity issues.

Ethan Brooks: Drafting runbook now, will ping for review.

Maya Patel: Thanks all — small check-in tomorrow 10am PT. If anyone needs to add risks or blockers here before then, drop them in this thread. :thumbsup:
